text.tspan: Place D1 beside SW1 so their private matrix
connection is short and easy to follow. Preserve
diode polarity and all pin connections, leave room
for labels and shared bus connections, and reroute
affected traces. Exact alignment is not required.
Complete 92-component TSX circuit; unchanged electrical connections.
Full analysis: only 3 unchanged decoupling-grouping findings remain (deferred to a separate PR).
